title: Best Presentation at Indonesia Green Jobs Initiative Competition

items.content: ClimatiX is an integrated climate technology ecosystem designed to improve transparency and trust in the carbon market. By combining the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing, and Blockchain, our platform enables real-time environmental monitoring, intelligent carbon analytics, and transparent digital carbon credit trading.
Our ecosystem consists of three interconnected platforms:

items.title: ClimatiX Devices
items.content: Collects real-time environmental data from conservation areas using IoT sensors.

items.title: ClimatiX LandHub
items.content: Transforms sensor data into actionable insights through AI-powered analytics, enabling project monitoring and carbon estimation.

items.title: ClimatiX GreenTrade
items.content: Tokenizes verified carbon credits into digital assets, creating a transparent marketplace for secure and traceable carbon credit transactions.
Together, these components provide an end-to-end solution that supports environmental conservation, ESG initiatives, and the transition toward a sustainable green economy.

We were deeply honored when ClimatiX was recognized with the Best Presentation Award at the GreenJob Competition organized by Inovasi Muda. Our project was awarded for its innovative approach to integrating IoT, AI, and Blockchain into a unified carbon technology ecosystem.

Furthermore, we were praised for presenting a practical, scalable, and impactful solution aimed at advancing transparency and digital transformation within the carbon market. This achievement reflects not only the technical innovation behind ClimatiX, but also our team's ability to communicate complex architectural ideas effectively to industry experts and judges.

title: Gold Medalist in Digital Technology - FIKSI 2024
competition: Festival Inovasi dan Kewirausahaan Siswa Indonesia (FIKSI) 2024
institution: Puspresnas, Kementerian Pendidikan, Kebudayaan, Riset, dan Teknologi (Kemendikbudristek)

items.content: Hellyos Ageng Haqiqie led the Velinked project as Project Manager, Chief Presenter, and Lead IoT Engineer. Developed as an innovative telematics solution for commercial vehicles, Velinked won the Gold Medal (Medali Emas) in Digital Technology at FIKSI 2024 (Festival Inovasi dan Kewirausahaan Siswa Indonesia) organized by Puspresnas, Kemendikbudristek RI. This foundational engineering work strongly connects to Hellyos's focus in Teknik Robotika dan Kecerdasan Buatan (TRKB) at Universitas Airlangga.
Velinked pairs two custom IoT devices—VeMonitor (GPS/telematics tracking) and VeControl (remote engine shut-off & safety)—with an intelligent dual-platform software ecosystem:

items.title: Web dashboard (fleet owners)
items.content: Real-time vehicle location & engine data, AI driver-behavior analytics, fuel expense oversight, remote vehicle control, and automated attendance management.

items.title: Mobile app (drivers)
items.content: One-tap expense uploads, online leave requests, digital task dispatching, and live status updates.

Hellyos spearheaded the technical architecture, business-model design, and product roadmap, delivering a pitch that outperformed national finalists across Indonesia. This milestone solidified Hellyos Ageng Haqiqie's leadership in high-stakes technological innovation, embedded systems, and enterprise software engineering.

sections.heading: Finalist in the FIKSI Competition in the field of Digital Technology 2023

items.content: Selected as a national finalist in the Digital Technology Business Plan category at FIKSI 2023, competing among top vocational students across Indonesia.

I developed an IoT-based aquaculture solution with real-time water quality monitoring (pH, temperature, TDS), automated pumps, and adaptive control for different fish species. This experience strengthened my skills in business model development, strategic planning, and pitching innovative tech-driven ideas.
